definition.question: How extensively are states integrating frontier AI into military systems and operations?
definition.low_end: Military AI remains limited to research and non-critical support functions with no deployed weaponized applications.
definition.high_end: Frontier AI is fully integrated into deployed autonomous weapons, targeting, and command-and-control across major militaries.

readings.rationale: Unassessed - no evidence in this batch on military AI programs, deployments, or doctrine; research needed on state military AI strategies, autonomous systems fielding, and AI-enabled C2 exercises/incidents.
